query:
SELECT 
  si.saleId,
  si.productId,
  si.quantity,
  p.name as productName,
  p.currentStock
FROM saleItems si
JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE si.saleId IN (22290008, 23340003, 34530041, 34530046, 34530078, 34530084, 34530101, 34530104, 34530133, 35040005, 36330007, 36810035)
ORDER BY si.saleId, si.productId
